title: Doctrine skill manifest (v1)
description: Canonical v1 schema for the YAML front matter of a doctrine skill (doctrine/skills/<name>/SKILL.md). A skill is a content-addressed, advisory priming artefact derived from named doctrine; it never holds approval or verification authority and MUST ship a sibling verifier pack at the conventional path (doctrine/patterns/verifier-packs.md section 6). The Markdown body carries the priming block inside exactly one fenced block whose info string is `priming`; doctrine.priming_block_sha256 is the SHA-256 of that block with LF line endings, fence lines excluded, ending in a single newline. scripts/validate-skills.py enforces the body rules, the hash, governing-path resolution, and sibling-pack existence; this schema validates front-matter shape only.

name.description: Skill id. MUST equal the directory name. Top-level name and description deliberately match the SKILL.md front-matter convention used by agent hosts so the file is consumable unchanged.

description.description: One-paragraph statement of what the skill primes an agent to do and when a host should load it.

license.description: Optional SPDX identifier when the skill licence differs from the library licence.

compatibility.description: Optional host-facing environment requirements, as in the common SKILL.md convention.

metadata.description: Optional string-to-string map reserved for host conventions. Library-governed fields live under `doctrine`, which is this schema's documented extension key; a host that rejects unknown top-level keys strips `doctrine` at vendoring time and keeps the hash-pinned body.

allowed-tools.description: Optional space-separated host tool allowlist, as in the common SKILL.md convention. Advisory to the host; it grants no authority under this library.

version.description: Skill version consumers pin as <name>@<version>. Any byte change to the priming block MUST bump at least the minor version; a change that narrows applicability or strengthens an instruction MUST bump the major version.

kind.description: primer = shapes behaviour across a task class; procedure = step-wise workflow that emits artefacts; assessment = grades a target against an owning checklist; design = design-time analysis method.

authority.description: Fixed. A skill is never approval, verification, or policy authority; those live in verifier packs, reviewers, and estate policy.

injection.description: explicit-only = loaded only when a run contract lists it; estate-policy = an estate MAY auto-inject through a versioned, evaluated policy (doctrine/patterns/anti-confabulation-priming.md section 4.1). The expanded run contract MUST show any injection either way.

status.description: Lifecycle state per doctrine/patterns/doctrine-content-lifecycle.md. deprecated MUST name superseded_by; retired skills keep their manifest as a tombstone and MUST NOT be loaded.

tier.description: 0 = always-on primers; 1 = agent change-lifecycle procedures; 2 = readiness assessments derived from checklists; 3 = design-time specialists. See doctrine/skills/README.md.

applies_to.description: Task classes the skill is intended for. Free text by design; estates map these onto their run-contract task taxonomy.

path.description: Repo-relative path of the principle, pattern, checklist, contract, or ADR the skill derives from. At least one entry MUST be a principle or pattern; a checklist alone cannot govern a skill because no obligation exists only in a checklist.

priming_block_bytes.description: Optional declared size of the priming block. The validator enforces the 4096-byte cap regardless: primers are injected into rendered prompts and an unbounded block is a context-budget hazard.

verifier_pack.description: Sibling pack path, fixed by doctrine/patterns/verifier-packs.md section 6. A skill that cannot point to its pack is inadmissible.

model_scope.description: Model or provider families the supporting evaluation covered. Absent or empty means no portable evaluation evidence exists and every host SHOULD treat the skill as experimental for its cell.

evidence.description: Repo-relative path or URL of the evaluation record that justifies model_scope; null states plainly that none exists.

owner.description: Accountable role, not a person, in the adopting estate; library-maintainers for the reference skill.

review_date.description: Date by which the skill MUST be reconfirmed or demoted; the lifecycle sweep flags overdue skills.
